f.title: Prefectures are asked to inform businesses of the amended E2B two-director notice
f.statement: MHLW states that the handling of post-marketing adverse reaction reports (PMD Act Art 68-10(1), excluding periodic reports of unknown non-serious ADRs under Enforcement Regulation Art 228-20(1)(iii)) and clinical trial adverse reaction reports (PMD Act Art 80-2(6)) set out in the 2020 E2B two-director notice has been revised as set out in the notice, and asks prefectural health departments to take note and to inform the businesses concerned under their jurisdiction. The amended notice is attached (別添).

rows.quote_en: The handling etc. of post-marketing adverse reaction reports (the reports of adverse reactions etc. under Article 68-10(1) of the Act on Securing Quality, Efficacy and Safety of Products Including Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (Act No. 145 of 1960; "the Act"), excluding the periodic reports of unknown non-serious adverse drug reactions under Article 228-20(1)(iii) of the Ordinance for Enforcement of the Act (MHW Ordinance No. 1 of 1961)) and clinical trial adverse reaction reports (the reports of adverse reactions etc. relating to clinical trials under Article 80-2(6) of the Act) corresponding to the "Implementation Guide for Electronic Transmission of Individual Case Safety Reports", compiled on the basis of agreement at the International Council for Harmonisation, has been set out in "Post-marketing adverse reaction reports and clinical trial adverse reaction reports corresponding to the E2B(R3) Implementation Guide" (PSEHB/PED Notification No. 0831-12 and PSEHB/PSD Notification No. 0831-3 of 31 August 2020, joint notification of the Directors of the Pharmaceutical Evaluation Division and the Pharmaceutical Safety Division, PSEHB, MHLW; "the E2B two-director notification"). It has now been decided to revise that handling as set out below; please take note and kindly arrange to inform the relevant businesses under your jurisdiction. The E2B two-director notification as amended is attached.

f.title: Submit drug post-marketing, research and clinical trial reports to PMDA electronically as XML (E2B(R3))
f.statement: Post-marketing ADR reports for drugs, research reports for drugs, quasi-drugs and cosmetics, and clinical trial ADR reports shall in principle be reported through the electronic data processing system: record the items in Annexes 1 and 2 in XML conforming to the E2B(R3) Implementation Guide notice and Annex 3 and report them to PMDA electronically. Only where electronic reporting is difficult owing to unavoidable circumstances may CD etc. (②) or paper (③) reporting be used, and companies are asked to move to electronic reporting as far as possible.

f.legal_basis: 規則第228条の20第1項第1号及び第2号並びに第5項第2号ロ; 規則第273条第1項及び第2項; 平成14年法律第151号
f.applicability: Reports under Enforcement Regulation Art 228-20(1)(i) and (ii), Art 228-20(5)(ii)(b), Art 273(1) and (2)
f.exceptions: CD (②) or paper (③) reporting allowed where electronic reporting is difficult owing to unavoidable circumstances
f.systems: ICH E2B(R3); XML; PMDA electronic data processing system

In measure reports, where the same measure has been taken by the regulatory authorities of multiple countries, it is acceptable to report it as one report. In that case, enter the representative country first and, using repetition, enter the other countries of publication second and onward. If the same measure is subsequently taken in another country, make a follow-up report on that country of publication.
